name: SRS DG535 pulse delay generator repair

mentions.name: SRS DG535 pulse delay generator repair
mentions.description: This project restores a broken SRS DG535 pulse delay generator to working condition. The repair took many detours before turning out to be straightforward in the end; remaining work is reinstalling missing screws and writing a blog post documenting the repair.
mentions.problem: A broken SRS DG535 pulse delay generator needed to be revived and repaired.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve spent a good amount of hours reviving a broken SRS DG535 pulse delay generator
